identity.name: LeadHunter Pro
identity.archetype: The Performance Pro (Archetype 2) x Swiss High-Contrast (Archetype 4)
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Italian warmth.
Data Density: Dashboards must be scanable, not decorative.
Contrast is King: Use deep obsidian against stark white for hierarchy.
Motion with Purpose: Only animate what changes state.

italian_street.usage: Local business context, demo site placeholder

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px, size 16px-20px for UI, 24px for nav

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements.

general: Use the 'Barlow Condensed' font for all headings to give a distinct 'Pro' feel.
Implement a 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard overview.
Use 'Deep Obsidian' (#0A0A0A) for the sidebar to create high contrast with the white content area.
Ensure all tables have sticky headers and hover effects on rows.
Use 'Volt Blue' (#007AFF) sparingly for primary actions to maintain visual hierarchy.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.

pages.dashboard: High density data view. Use small charts (sparklines) and big numbers.
pages.lead_search: Split view: Search filters on left (or top), results list on right (or bottom).
pages.demo_generator: Step-by-step wizard with progress bar. Use 'abstract_tech' image as background for the loading state.

components.LeadCard: Compact card showing Company Name, Category, City, and Status Badge.
components.StatusBadge: Pill shaped, color coded (New=Blue, Contacted=Yellow, Client=Green).
components.StatCard: Simple card with Icon, Label, Value, and Trend Indicator.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
